note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the What's New panel in the User Admin Dashboard AND for FLOWRA_Whats_New.pdf. Edit this file to update both surfaces at once. Regenerate PDF via `python /app/scripts/generate_whats_new_pdf.py`.

entries.title: Busy Sync Agent v1.5.0 — Enriched Customer Sync
entries.desc: Direct-ODBC extract now pulls party group hierarchy, WhatsApp-normalized mobile, email, GST/PAN, split address, station, city, state, price category, salesman link and closing balance. 100% our own — no dependency on any third-party Busy connector.

entries.title: CA Corner — Bank & Investor Reports False 'No FY data' Error
entries.desc: Preview now correctly detects every FY present in Tally sales_vouchers (derived from voucher_date range instead of a non-existent scalar 'fy' field). Historicals also pull real per-FY sales/purchases via total_amount.

entries.title: Analytics — Sales Frequency Readability
entries.desc: Increased row height and padding on the Sales Frequency table so item names, top customers and totals no longer feel cramped.

entries.title: Busy Sync Agent v1.3.1
entries.desc: pyodbc bundled + Busy DB password fallback chain (Busy 21/18/older) + BUSY_DB_PASSWORD override field in Settings.

entries.title: Tally Agent v9.8.30 — Forward-Dated Voucher Fix
entries.desc: Quick-sync window now extends to today, not stops at stored LVD. Reconcile is date-scoped — prevents mass deletions when a voucher is added with a future date.

entries.title: Busy Sync Agent v1.2 — Full Tally Parity
entries.desc: Complete 1:1 Tally clone GUI: 4 connectivity cards, Sync Status panel, Subscription block with Request Renewal, auto-detect companies + FYs on folder pick.

entries.title: Investor Pitch Kit
entries.desc: 16-page pitch PDF + 10-page cold-email teaser + editable Excel projection model. Auto-generated from a single source of truth.

entries.title: Tally Agent v9.8.29 — LVD & AlterID Persist
entries.desc: Per-company LVD + AlterID + timestamp saved to disk. 7-day full-sync skip window if AlterID unchanged.

entries.title: Marketing Kit
entries.desc: Auto-generated pitch decks (detailed + pointers), print-ready visiting cards (front/back QR), Tally-vs-Busy-vs-FLOWRA comparison charts.

entries.title: Inventory Export Bugs
entries.desc: CSV/Excel list→string coercion, PDF payload updates, multi-group filter fix. All export formats now handle nested product data correctly.

entries.title: Beat Run — Mandatory Order/Payment + Close Day
entries.desc: Yes/No flags on every stop. Unplanned existing-customer dropdown. End-of-Day PDF & Excel with breakdown by salesman.

entries.title: Salesman Copy-From
entries.desc: One-click copy of another salesman's customer mapping + beat plan. Speeds up new-hire onboarding by ~90%.

entries.title: Employee Active/Deactivate Toggle
entries.desc: Deactivate a user without deleting audit history. Deactivated users lose login but their data + reports remain intact.

entries.title: Tally Agent v9.8.28 — SVCurrentCompany Fix
entries.desc: Fixed XML header format that some Tally builds rejected. Zero errors on 5,000+ voucher syncs after fix.

entries.title: Cancel Dispatch Cards
entries.desc: Cancel a card up to the Packed lane with a reason; cancelled cards strikethrough until end-of-day, then auto-archive.

entries.title: Tally Invoice Drift Detection
entries.desc: Cards now auto-flag (amber/red badge) when the source Tally invoice is modified or deleted after sync — no silent drift.

entries.title: Fuzzy Search Everywhere
entries.desc: "tvs 10" now finds "TVS-10", "TVS(10)", "TVS/10". Spaces and separators (- / ( ) ! : . , & _) ignored across all search boxes.

entries.title: SPIP — 12-Month Rolling Window
entries.desc: Added rolling 12-month fallback and a "No Movement" bucket for idle items. Aliases included in global search.

entries.title: SPIP & YoY Limits Removed
entries.desc: Lifted the 5,000-row cap so all items surface in SPIP. Cross-FY YoY sales comparison + forecast tables added.

entries.title: Mobile Performance
entries.desc: Server-side pagination + render caps for Inventory and Customer CRM. Tally API delay 2s → 0.5s. New compound DB indexes.

entries.title: Tally Agent v9.8.7
entries.desc: Standard price via STANDARDPRICELIST, root-group hierarchy, and item alias (LANGUAGENAME) extraction.

entries.title: CA Corner BS & P&L Parity
entries.desc: Fixed Assets, Sundry Debtors and Creditors re-mapped via root-group hierarchy. Removed double-counting of Stock-in-Hand.

entries.title: Beat Run Monthly Report
entries.desc: Salesman beat coverage and visit summary, exportable to Excel.

entries.title: Dispatch Terminal
entries.desc: Kanban board, LR tracking, document uploads, porter settlement.

entries.title: Outstanding Calculation Fixed
entries.desc: Opening balances per FY and journal voucher party amounts corrected.

entries.title: Desktop Agent v9
entries.desc: Deletion reconciliation, command queue, dual-schedule syncing.

entries.title: CRM Targets Overhaul
entries.desc: Bulk targets, customer removal/reactivation, read-only past FYs.

entries.title: Digital Questionnaire
entries.desc: Public customer forms with SuperAdmin leads and Excel export.
